adaptation: Capture the typed source pointer exactly once in a GNU statement expression, then retain the null conditional and original inherited-pointer conversion. The original GNU11/Clang profile accepts typeof and statement expressions. No sanitizer is disabled.
compiler_observation: Clang18.1.3 -O1 with fatal undefined sanitizer diagnoses the anonymous-union member expression in the unevaluated true branch of a literal-NULL conditional. The retained reduced reproducer demonstrates the same compiler interaction outside RM.

cpp.scope: Exact macro bytes extracted from checked prelude.h and compiled in a reduced C++ anonymous-union/inheritance fixture. Full original NVOC C header C++ compatibility is not claimed.

full_original_host_validation.leak_sanitizer: Disabled only in explicit Linux local run because container process-inspection support is unavailable; host/service accounting verified zero. Native Apple builder retains default sanitizer configuration.

limits: The full original NVOC headers predate C++ compatibility: qualified anonymous bit-fields and C99 array designators reject direct C++ inclusion. The new macro control does not silently rewrite those unrelated headers.
These controls do not establish kernel stack safety, global kernel startup, adapter startup or GPU operation.
original_contract: staticCast already checks its source for NULL before the conversion; do not infer an actual runtime null dereference from the sanitizer diagnosis.
